newsitem.title: USA: CME to raise initial margins on DJ Taiwan stock.
newsitem.headline: CME to raise initial margins on DJ Taiwan stock.

text.p: The Chicago Mercantil Exchange (CME) will raise initial margins on its Dow Jones Taiwan Stock Index futures contracts as required by the Taiwan SEC, the exchange said on Friday in a bulletin to its membership.
The exchange said it agreed to raise initial margins on speculative accounts to seven percent, from 3.1 percent, once Taiwanese investors can particpate in the CME-Dow Jones Taiwan stock index.
On March 5, the Taiwan SEC announced its decision to lift its ban on local trading of offshore Taiwan stock-index futures contracts.
